'''2008 Worlds Team Scott Lingrell DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Starting written Kashyyyk; Black Sun Fleet package treated as Agents Of Black Sun. Side Dark on full sheet. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
